question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'had tasted'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​The past perfect tense 'had tasted' appropriately fits the blank as it suggests an action completed in the past before another past action. In this context, it implies that the protagonist had experienced (tasted) the salt air and the thrill of travel and adventure before making the decision to go back to sea.
